tasks.title: Rust: docserver page-render API — GET /api/documents/{id}/pages/{n}.png via wo-docx-renderer
tasks.description: Unblock ORM-09 PageThumbnails: the paginated raster output exists in wo-docx-renderer (pipeline.rs render_page(docx,page_num) -> RenderOutput::Png) but the docserver does not expose it. Create core/crates/wo-docserver/src/render.rs: (1) add wo-docx-renderer to Cargo.toml deps (path dep, same workspace version style as existing deps); (2) route GET /api/documents/{id}/pages/{n}.png — handler loads the stored document bytes (follow how collab/api_ext handlers resolve a document id to bytes via state.store), renders page n (1-based) with RenderConfig for PNG at query param w= target pixel width (default 120, cap 1024; scale = w / page_width_pt * 96/72 roughly — keep simple: render then it is fine to serve full-size; the browser scales), respond image/png with Cache-Control: no-cache (docs mutate). Query count=1 (or path /pages/count.json returning {"pages":N}) gives the page count via layout_pages(). Out-of-range -> 400 with clear message; unknown id -> 404 mirroring other handlers. (3) Register routes in lib.rs router next to the collab routes; render.rs module decl. (4) In-module tests (pattern of lib.rs #[test]s — build the router, request page 1 of a tiny in-memory docx fixture stored via the store test helper if one exists, else construct Router with state and call the handler fn directly): png magic bytes returned, 404 unknown id, 400 page 0 / page > count. If a full docx fixture is impractical in unit tests, test count=0 case with an empty-store doc returning 404 and unit-test the renderer wiring via a public helper exposed from render.rs (render_page_png(bytes, n, w) -> Result<Vec<u8>>) against a real minimal docx built with the same helpers other docserver tests use (grep docx_util.rs). Keep cargo test -p wo-docserver green (baseline ~65 tests across modules).

tasks.accept: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && grep -q 'wo-docx-renderer' core/crates/wo-docserver/Cargo.toml && test -f core/crates/wo-docserver/src/render.rs && grep -q 'mod render' core/crates/wo-docserver/src/lib.rs && grep -qE 'pages/\{n\}\.png|pages/count' core/crates/wo-docserver/src/lib.rs && timeout 550 cargo test -p wo-docserver --lib 2>&1 | grep -q 'test result: ok' && wc -l plan/oo-port/PORT-PLAN.md

tasks.title: JS: PageThumbnails rail — thumbnail strip, current-page highlight, click-to-scroll
tasks.description:
Unblock ORM-09 PageThumbnails (view+controller rows). Add a left thumbnail rail to the document editor: (1) DOM:
with a toggle button in the view menu / statusbar area (follow how the right panel toggle btn-right-panel-toggle is wired — mirror it: btn-thumbnails-toggle) and a vertical strip of ; (2) JS: openThumbnails() fetches /api/documents/{id}/pages/count.json then lazy-loads each page as pages/{n}.png (IntersectionObserver or simple loop, cap first 10 then on-scroll continue — keep it simple: load all if count <= 50); the current document id is available where the protect dialog gets it (grep api("protect") — follow the same id resolution); (3) current-page highlight: track the editor scroll (existing scroll/pagination state — grep for page tracking; if none exists, approximate by scroll fraction * count, rounded) and set .current on the matching thumb; (4) click thumb -> scroll editor to that page (scrollTo fraction n/count) and record command 'view.page-thumbnails' via the existing data-wo-cmd/recordCommand ledger; (5) i18n en+de: View.PageThumbnails, Thumbnails.Title, Thumbnails.Page ('Seite {n}'/'Page {n}'); (6) style.css: rail width 140px, thumbs bordered, .current highlighted, collapsed state hidden. Keep every existing .test.mjs green (run tabs.test.mjs at minimum — cwd note: tests read ./ relative files, run from the app dir). Flip plan/oo-port/ui-webapp.json: the two PageThumbnails rows (controller+view) and the Pages model row -> wo_status 'hosted' with notes 'PTS: thumbnails rail over /api/documents/{id}/pages/*.png (wo-docx-renderer)' (keep counts summing to 217). Test page-thumbnails.test.mjs (print THUMBNAILS-PASS): rail ids present in index.html, toggle wired, count fetch + per-page img loading code present, click handler + current-page logic present, i18n en+de, ledger rows flipped (parse ui-webapp.json, assert zero rows with wo_status blocked AND component matching PageThumbnails/Pages).

tasks.title: JS: HintManager — hint/toast service + first hints wired, ledger flip
tasks.description: Close the last small blocked ORM-09 row: HintManager (controller, blocked on a hint service). Implement a minimal hint service in editor.js (NOT a new file — small): window-level WoHints = { show(key, opts), dismiss(), persist dismissal in localStorage wo-hints-seen } rendering a small toast <div id=hint-toast data-wo-hint> bottom-center with text + 'Got it' dismiss button (aria-live=polite). Wire 3 first hints (the OO pattern is contextual onboarding): (1) first open of a document with >0 comments shows Comments hint; (2) first time the editor gains focus with track-changes ON shows track-changes hint; (3) first time the thumbnails rail opens (PTS-T2) shows page-navigation hint. Each hint: i18n en+de key Hints.<name>, dismissal persists, recordCommand 'hint.shown' with the key. Flip ui-webapp.json HintManager row -> hosted with note 'PTS: WoHints toast service'. Test hints.test.mjs (print HINTS-PASS): WoHints object + toast container present, 3 hint call sites greppable, i18n en+de for all 3 keys, localStorage dismissal key, ledger HintManager not blocked. Keep existing tests green.
